question: Evaluate $\begin{vmatrix}1+a&1&1\\1&1+a&1\\1&1&1+a\end{vmatrix}$ using suitable determinant operations.
explanation:
Step 1: Apply a column operation
Use $C_1\to C_1+C_2+C_3$. The determinant becomes $$\begin{vmatrix}a+3&1&1\\a+3&1+a&1\\a+3&1&1+a\end{vmatrix}$$
Step 2: Take out the common factor
Taking $a+3$ common from the first column gives $$(a+3)\begin{vmatrix}1&1&1\\1&1+a&1\\1&1&1+a\end{vmatrix}$$
Step 3: Simplify the rows
Apply $R_2\to R_2-R_1$ and $R_3\to R_3-R_1$. This gives $$(a+3)\begin{vmatrix}1&1&1\\0&a&0\\0&0&a\end{vmatrix}$$
Step 4: Evaluate
The remaining determinant is triangular. Hence, its value is $$a^2(a+3)$$
